lead: Runtime diagnostics and current execution-local reclamation-domain introspection (VM coroutine heap or AOT execution arena). Use `runtime.liveBytes()`, `runtime.liveObjects()`, or `runtime.info()` to inspect live memory. Reclamation is pure reference counting: an object dies when its last strong reference goes; cycles are not collected and are bounded by the physical coroutine domain (spec 16.8).
